output_list.reason: The 'totalLockedRewardsOf[_to] += _value' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. If '_value' is large enough, 'totalLockedRewardsOf[_to]' can overflow and become very small, allowing attackers to lock arbitrary amounts of tokens in users' accounts.

The 'totalLockedRewardsOf[msg.sender] -= _value' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. If '_value' is large enough, 'totalLockedRewardsOf[msg.sender]' can overflow and become very large, allowing attackers to unlock arbitrary amounts of tokens from users' accounts.

The 'totalLockedRewardsOf[addr] -= _value' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. If '_value' is large enough, 'totalLockedRewardsOf[addr]' can overflow and become very small, allowing attackers to unlock arbitrary amounts of tokens from users' accounts.

The 'reward' function does not check if the caller is a rewarder, allowing anyone to reward arbitrary addresses, including smart contract recipients that do not implement the receiveApproval function.

The 'transferReward' function does not check if the caller is a rewarder, allowing anyone to transfer reward tokens to arbitrary addresses, including smart contract recipients that do not implement the receiveApproval function.
